description: Parameters name which customer secrets hold the upstream URL and API key, so one offering can serve many distinct backends per customer.
name: byoe-params
summary: BYOE echo relay with per-enrollment secret selection.

api_key.description: API key for the upstream. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again. Leave empty if the upstream needs no key.

base_url.description: Upstream base URL for this enrollment (e.g. https://api.example.com)
